verdict: The accepted version keeps every claim and every fit of v1. The changes concentrate on measurement method: a new main-text section and new Fig. 1 panels on how out-of-plane field effects are removed, a parallel-field (theta = 0) null control, error bars and a Methods section on uncertainty, and a definition of the W_sc -> infinity device. The coherence-length model gains interpretive sentences and a confinement caveat, but no uncertainty, transparency estimate or second model. The orbital interpretation of B_eta, the B* spin-orbit argument and the alternative mechanisms (kinetic inductance, device spread) are left as they were, so referees either did not press them or accepted a rebuttal. The new Methods gives a 2DEG density and mean free path (8.14e11 cm^-2, 147 nm) that disagree with the values the main text uses (6e12 cm^-2, 130 nm).

inferred_requests.title: Measure the field-parallel-to-current control
inferred_requests.text: Measure eta with the in-plane field along the current, where the intended mechanisms predict little or no diode effect, to rule out extrinsic contributions.

inferred_requests.text: Describe the W_sc -> infinity device, which carries much of the I_c fit and the eta trend, and justify treating it as the infinite-width limit.

issue_status.reason: The orbital fit, Phi/Phi0 range, saturation claim and abstract are unchanged. Only the Conclusion adds a coexistence hedge. The review's 'typo' point was a misreading: v1 already said 'none ... are a particularly good match'.

The W_sc -> infinity device is now defined and the fabrication is described, but there is still one device per width, no R_n, I_cR_n or transparency, no measured W_sc, and no cooldown-by-device record.

Interpretive sentences (diffusive correlations, Andreev reflection at a distal S/N edge, confinement caveat) were added, but the amplitude/probability argument, the tau and phase assumption, and the missing uncertainty on xi are unchanged.
The B* gate argument is unchanged: Eq. 3 is not evaluated numerically and alpha(V_g) and tau(V_g) are not measured. Only error bars were added.
B* now has fit standard errors and eta(0) is zero within uncertainty, but the fit window, field-zero calibration and branch-by-branch B* are still not given.

The compensation procedure is now in the main text, with Fraunhofer maps, an account of B_perp+ vs B_perp- and a misalignment estimate. This is shown for one representative device, with no test of varying the window.
Kinetic inductance and the phase drop along the strip are still mentioned only in passing. No estimate was added.
The text now says the Al etch stops at the semiconductor and frames the rear edge as an S/N interface, but it does not discuss the consequences for Eq. 2 or the current path into the strips.
The infinite-width device is now defined and Fig. 5a has uncertainty bands, but the jump to the infinite-width device is unexplained and the abstract claim is unchanged.
Fig. 1h adds eta at theta = 0 against theta = pi/2, with a misalignment estimate, though for one representative device rather than the narrowest and widest.
The base temperature, switching-current protocol and fit-based uncertainties are now given, but switching statistics, sweep reversal and error bars on Figs. 3b, 5b and 5c are absent.
The Josephson-vortex explanation for excluding the infinite-width point is unchanged and has no estimate.
The gate dependence of eta remains in the SI.
The gate-lead asymmetry is not discussed. The new text attributes B_perp offsets to asymmetric J_c(x) in general.
The captions still do not give the exact negative gate voltage per device. Point values cannot be checked from the text layer.
No fit equation, intercept or uncertainty is given in the text or caption of Fig. 5c. The legend cannot be read from the text layer.
The main text still infers the Al thickness from the critical field, but Methods now gives a nominal 10 nm growth thickness. The lambda_L limit and the thickness uncertainty are still not discussed.
Fig. 1 is expanded and the cross section is a separate schematic, but the colour scheme is unchanged. Whether the leads and mesa are labelled cannot be confirmed from the text layer.
The resonance condition is still stated without comparison to data.
Methods lists the quantum-well layers bottom to top. The d = 10-17 nm range is still tied only to Fig. 2.

unaddressed_major.title: Orbital interpretation of B_eta not tested by the fit
unaddressed_major.why: It is the paper's central interpretive claim and an obvious target. The added coexistence hedge and the renaming of the estimates to B_eta suggest an exchange, while the fit and claims stay unchanged.

unaddressed_major.title: B* gate dependence attributed to spin-orbit coupling without measured inputs
unaddressed_major.why: Apart from error bars, nothing in the B* section changed, not even wording, which suggests referees accepted the qualitative argument.

unaddressed_major.title: Kinetic inductance and current distribution along narrow strips
unaddressed_major.why: No estimate or wording change. The new confinement caveat addresses a different alternative.

unaddressed_major.title: Exclusion of the infinite-width point justified by Josephson vortices
unaddressed_major.why: The sentence is unchanged. The new device definition answers what the device is, not why it deviates.
